content.value_statement: Paid campaigns can waste spend when bid targets start from guesses or aspirational goals. This skill turns conversion history into a bid strategy, target, portfolio map, and learning-phase plan.
actual_capabilities: Chooses between tCPA, tROAS, max-conversions, max-conversion-value, and manual CPC based on goals and data volume.
Calculates starting tCPA or tROAS targets from trailing CPA, ROAS, and conversion history.
Labels each input as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated so assumptions stay visible.
Groups campaigns into bid portfolios only when goals, targets, and funnel stages match.
Creates a learning-phase entry plan with do-not-touch windows and reset risks.
Produces a handoff summary for ad account auditing before launch.
limitations: It does not allocate budgets across campaigns.
It does not manage live pacing or scale changes after launch.
It requires conversion history or a user decision to start without a target.
It does not replace platform-specific policy or account compliance review.

use_cases.title: Launch a Search Campaign
use_cases.description: Select a starting bid strategy and target from the last 30 days of conversion data.

use_cases.title: Restructure Campaign Portfolios
use_cases.description: Group campaigns by shared goal, target range, and funnel stage before launch.

use_cases.title: Audit Learning-Phase Risk
use_cases.description: Identify target or budget changes that could reset learning before the plan goes live.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Basic Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Pick a bid strategy for this campaign. Goal: [goal]. Last 30 days: [CPA or ROAS], [conversion count], [funnel stage].

prompt_templates.title: Set an Initial Target
prompt_templates.prompt: Set a starting tCPA or tROAS target. Use this history: [trailing CPA or ROAS], [monthly conversions], [business goal]. Label every input source.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Portfolio Grouping
prompt_templates.prompt: Group these campaigns into bid portfolios: [campaign list with goals, targets, budgets, funnel stages, and conversion volume]. Explain what stays separate.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Learning-Phase Entry Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full bid strategy plan with starting target math, portfolio grouping, do-not-touch window, reset risks, and auditor handoff for [campaign set].

output_examples.input: DR campaign with 90 conversions last month and a trailing CPA of $42.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: tCPA. Starting target: about $42 to $46, because recent volume is adequate and the target should begin near achieved CPA.

output_examples.input: Revenue campaign with 22 conversions and stable order value data.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: max-conversion-value without a tROAS target. The account needs more volume before a target can learn reliably.

output_examples.input: Four campaigns with different funnel stages and CPA ranges.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: keep prospecting separate from DR. Group only campaigns with shared goals and comparable target economics.

best_practices: Provide recent CPA, ROAS, conversion volume, goal, and funnel stage before asking for target math.
Use measured account data when possible, and label estimated benchmarks clearly.
Wait through the learning-phase window before changing targets or budgets.
anti_patterns: Do not set tCPA or tROAS from an aspirational goal the account has never achieved.
Do not mix prospecting and direct response campaigns in one bid portfolio.
Do not change targets during learning unless the plan explicitly accepts a reset.

faq.question: Can this skill choose between tCPA and tROAS?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses goal type, conversion volume, and value data to recommend the better strategy.

faq.question: Does it need live ad platform access?
faq.answer: No. It can work from pasted or exported account history. Connectors only improve measurement accuracy.

faq.question: Can it allocate my campaign budget?
faq.answer: No. It plans bidding strategy and targets. Budget allocation belongs to a separate budgeting workflow.

faq.question: What happens if I have no conversion history?
faq.answer: It asks for history or recommends a no-target learning entry such as max-conversions.

faq.question: Can it help after a campaign is live?
faq.answer: It can explain reset risks, but live pacing and scale moves require a pacing workflow.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
